content.title: About
content.content: Coffee, pre‑sweetened with sugar, is a ground or instant coffee product that already contains added sugar. It is convenient for quick preparation without the need to add a sweetener separately. The flavor combines the characteristic bitterness of coffee with a gentle sweetness.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pre‑sweetened coffee is popular in countries with high consumption of ready‑to‑drink beverages, such as the United States and Japan.
The added sugar helps soften coffee’s acidity and bitterness, making it more appealing to a broad audience.
There are several variants: white sugar, brown sugar, or cane syrup.
Some brands add flavorings (vanilla, caramel) to enhance taste notes.
Instant pre‑sweetened coffee is often used in offices and at events because of its convenience.

items.title: Quick energy boost
items.content: Sugar provides a rapid glucose surge, while coffee stimulates the central nervous system, helping increase alertness.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Coffee is rich in polyphenols, which may protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Improved concentration
items.content: Caffeine enhances attention and cognitive performance, especially when consumed in moderate amounts.

items.title: Elevated blood sugar
items.content: Regular consumption of sweetened coffee can raise glucose levels, which is undesirable for people with diabetes.

items.title: Caffeine‑induced anxiety
items.content: High caffeine intake may increase anxiety, insomnia, and heart rate.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Coffee can irritate the stomach, especially in individuals with gastritis or ulcer disease.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Dissolve 1‑2 teaspoons in hot water (80‑90 °C) or add to milk. It can also be used in smoothies, desserts, and ice cream to impart a coffee‑sweet flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a sealed package in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. For long‑term storage, keep refrigerated to prevent clumping and loss of aroma.
